title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00115 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Cleaned and cleared rig floor. Meanwhile performed AAR
00:15 - 00:30: Prepared to n/d diverter system. Carried out TBT
00:30 - 02:00: N/d diverter
02:00 - 02:45: Shifted load to BOP carrier. Removed tension cylinders and broke off NT-2 connector
02:45 - 03:15: Lifted BOP. Skidded and landed BOP onto test stump
03:15 - 03:45: Removed scaffolding in moonpool. Meanwhile loosen HP riser on wellhead and prepared for to rig up bleed off manifold.
03:45 - 04:15: Installed lifting gear on HP riser and lifted same to the drill floor
04:15 - 05:45: Removed half moon hatch and installed hatch on f-1. Meanwhile prepared for skidding continue reporting on f-11b
